title: The Subject
text: No one has seen it. That is the first line of every report. Listening Post 4 tracked a slow, regular seismic source for years and logged it only as SUBJECT. The Zarya driller called it the neighbor. Crews describe a pressure in the ears, a hum in the deck plates, a long note like a bow drawn across steel cable. It follows vibration: drills, charges, pumps, voices carried through a hull. It loses the trail in silence and in soft rock. Its size, estimated from seismograph traces, falls somewhere between a locomotive and a mountain range. The estimate is not considered useful.
teaser: Nobody has seen it. Everybody has heard it.
